newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dlr firms as stock surge woos foreign cash.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dlr firms as stock surge woos foreign cash.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed slightly higher against its U.S. counterpart on Wednesday as the island's booming stock market attracted strong inflows of investment funds from overseas, dealers said.
The local unit ended at T$27.489 against Tuesday's T$27.490 close.
Turnover through dealers was an active US$203.5 million.
Taiwan's stock index has gained some 400 points since November 15, with heavy daily turnover topping or nearing T$100 billion in recent sessions.
"The bullish market prompted many investors to remit funds into Taiwan and to buy Taiwan dollars to invest in stocks," said one dealer at a foreign bank.
On the other hand, routine month-end demand for U.S. dollars prevented the Taiwan dollar from rising too much, dealers said.
They expected the rate to remain in a consolidation on Thursday, forecasting a tight T$27.48-50 trading range.
